name: Ganesha Rudraksha
description: Recognised by a naturally grown trunk-like projection and associated with Ganesha, this formation is traditionally chosen for wisdom, auspicious beginnings, focus, and obstacle-clearing prayer.
alt: Representative render of a Ganesha Nepali Rudraksha with a natural trunk-like formation on deep green stone
note: Illustrative render only. Ganesha is a natural formation, not a separate face count. The protrusion must not be carved; the actual bead’s mukhi, origin, lab documentation, and authenticity must be verified.
